name: Mulla Sadra (Sadr al-Din Shirazi)
shortBio: Master of the Safavid School of Isfahan and Transcendent Theosophy; established the Primacy of Existence (Asalat al-Wujud) over essence and Substantial Motion (al-Harakah al-Jawhariyyah).
centralQuestion: Does existence constitute the sole fundamental reality of all beings, undergoing continuous internal substantial change toward higher intensities of consciousness?

keyWorks.title: The Transcendent Philosophy of the Four Journeys of the Intellect (Al-Asfar al-Arba'a)
keyWorks.description: Magnum opus systematically synthesizing peripatetic logic, illuminationist metaphysics, and Sufi gnosis.

keyWorks.title: The Book of Metaphysical Penetrations (Kitab al-Masha'ir)
keyWorks.description: Concise masterwork demonstrating the primacy, univocity, and systematic ambiguity (tashkik) of existence.
